title: Chapter 90 Luo Li Is Resurrected
content:
Chapter 90 Luo Li Is Resurrected

"How did you do it?"

At this time, the young man from the Time and Space Hall said in a deep voice.

However, Lu Daosheng ignored him.

Because it was at a critical moment, even Lu Daosheng couldn't help but observe this despicable move carefully.

The condensed soul gradually combined with the woman's body, and continued to overflow with the strong vitality.

This process lasted for several hours.

During this period, several strange forces continued to gush out from Lu Daosheng's hands.

Just looking at it is already extremely complicated.

I don’t know how long it took, but the movement finally slowly disappeared.

Bang!

A slight heartbeat sounded from the woman's body.

It was very weak, but it shook the hearts of everyone present.

Lived.

Really alive!

"Luo Li!"

Yu Qingfeng's eyes were red, and he could no longer help but rushed towards the woman.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng did not disturb him, but turned around and looked at the silent young man beside him.

"how?"

Lu Daosheng Dao.

After a moment of silence, the young man looked at Lu Daosheng deeply and said, "I lost, I will not blame this matter."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

At this time, the young man said again: "If you do this, you will offend some forces that you cannot imagine. Are you afraid?"

Although he didn't understand why Lu Daosheng was safe and sound, he felt it was necessary to remind the other party.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

"Thank you for your kindness, but my strength is not weak."

Upon hearing this, the young man shrugged.

Anyway, I can't beat you, and you're right.

Then the young man said, "Then please be blessed and say goodbye."

After saying that, the young man trembled and left here directly.

Even he couldn't understand Lu Daosheng's methods, so he naturally would not choose to offend Lu Daosheng.

However, Lu Daosheng's actions will definitely offend those existences, so he will not please Lu Daosheng too much.

After all, maybe one day, Lu Daosheng suddenly disappeared.

Seeing the young man's departure, Lu Daosheng shook his head and then turned around to look.

I saw that Yu Qingfeng was hugging the woman named Luo Li tightly.

Jiangbei and Yu Qingfeng were waiting aside.

"Luo Li, Luo Li, wake up."

At this time, Yu Qingfeng looked at Luo Li in his arms with a worried look on his face.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng bounced his fingers and a stream of energy poured into Luo Li's body.

The next moment, Luo Li's eyelids trembled and she finally woke up.

"Me, what's wrong with me?"

Luo Li looked at the sky with a little dazed eyes, and she felt that she had a dream, a very long dream.

At this time, when Luo Li heard a familiar voice in her ears, she was stunned and her eyes gradually focused.

A familiar but somewhat unfamiliar face appeared in her vision.

"Qing, Qingfeng?"

Seeing Yu Qingfeng, Luo Li couldn't believe it.

After tens of millions of years, I heard my beloved woman say her name again. At this moment, Yu Qingfeng cried like a child.

"Luo Li, it's me, I'm back."

"Qingfeng, it's really you. I miss you very much."

"Luo Li, I miss you very much."

The two of them hugged each other and cried without any extra words.

Watching the two hugging each other, Kong Wen, who was standing beside him, silently wiping the tears from the corners of his eyes.

The knot of my heart that had been in the past years was finally untied.

Jiangbei did not cry, but had a bright smile on his face.

He was really happy for Yu Qingfeng.

At this time, Kong Wen suddenly knelt down towards Lu Daosheng.

"Senior, no matter what, please accept my Confucius worship."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng raised his hand and easily dragged Kong Wen up.

"You're welcome, after all, I'm not a scammer."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

However, Lu Daosheng's eyes looked at Kong Wen were filled with a hint of complexity.

At this time, Yu Qingfeng finally reacted.

After a long time.

Yu Qingfeng pulled Luo Li and knelt down towards Lu Daosheng.

"Senior Lu, from now on, I, Yu Qingfeng, will be sent by my mission."

"Thank you for saving your life, senior. There is nothing that I can repay you. From now on, I am willing to serve you as your maid."

Just now, Yu Qingfeng had already informed her of everything, and she now knew everything.

It was the existence in front of her who saved her.

To be precise, she was resurrected.

She has no ability and can only repay her with this method.

Lu Daosheng was quite satisfied when he heard Yu Qingfeng's words, but Luo Li's words made Lu Daosheng's face stunned.

"Ahem, let's forget about the maid. From now on, Yu Qingfeng will be mine. You can live with her well."

Hearing this, Luo Li was just stunned, but didn't say anything, and nodded.

Yu Qingfeng was extremely moved inside.

Seniors are so nice.

At this moment, a click sound suddenly sounded from Yu Qingfeng's body.

The next moment, a terrifying aura suddenly surged out of Yu Qingfeng's body.

The state that had been stagnant for tens of millions of years was completely broken at the moment when the inner demon was untied.

God Emperor Realm!

Seeing this scene, Jiang Bei smiled and said, "Brother Yu, congratulations."

Kong Wen laughed loudly when he saw this.

At this moment, he was extremely proud.

Lu Daosheng was not too surprised that Yu Qingfeng broke through to the God Emperor Realm.

It was natural.

If he hadn't broken through at this time, it would be that he, Lu Daosheng, had misjudged him.

And the entire Qingling Star Region noticed the movement of breaking through the God Emperor Realm.

"What?! There is actually a God Emperor Realm in my Qingling Star Region?!"

How long has it been since the Wu Shen of the Wuling Star Region broke through to the God Emperor Realm.

Unexpectedly, the God Emperor Realm expert of the Qingling Star Region followed closely.

"Hahahaha, God bless my Qingling Star Region!"

"Quick, check quickly, I want to know which senior broke through."

For a while, the entire Qingling Star Region began to get busy.

For this breath, only a few people were familiar with it.

Some of the older generation of experts looked solemnly at the God Emperor Realm breath that soared into the sky in the void, frowning.

This is the breath of Yu Qingfeng.

But, didn't this guy die a long time ago?

Sure enough, those were all rumors. This guy is not dead. He is probably hiding in a place and breaking through in seclusion.

Thinking of this, a smile appeared on their faces.

Now, the capital of their Qingling Star Region has also increased.

However, when they found the place, Yu Qingfeng and his people had already disappeared.

"Master, are you really not going with me?"

In the void, Yu Qingfeng looked at Kong Wen and said.

Kong Wen shook his head.

"Master, I am relieved to see you become a real strong man. Now, I just want to enjoy my old age in this small place."

Some people pursue immortality and invincibility, but some people do not.

He has lived long enough and has little interest in immortality and invincibility.

Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng looked gloomy, but he didn't say anything more.

"Master, take care."

Yu Qingfeng left, and left here with Lu Daosheng and went to the deserted city.

Kong Wen stood there, watching Yu Qingfeng leave.

Until Yu Qingfeng's figure completely disappeared, Kong Wen finally showed a long-lost smile, and finally turned into a ball of light and disappeared into the void.

He, in fact, had died a long time ago.
